html:
West Francia was the western kingdom of the Franks, from the Treaty of Verdun in 843 to 987, and the first stage of the Kingdom of France. It is on the map for 900.

It was created when the grandsons of Charlemagne split the Carolingian Empire; its first king was Charles the Bald. Its eastern neighbour was East Francia.

Its kings were weak, and power passed to great nobles. Viking fleets sailed up its rivers. In 885 to 886 Count Odo defended Paris through a long siege and was later chosen king, the first not of Charlemagne's line. In 911 King Charles the Simple gave land around Rouen to the Viking leader Rollo, the beginning of Normandy. For most of the 900s Carolingian kings and Odo's family, the Robertians, took turns on the throne, until the nobles elected Hugh Capet in 987. His family ruled France for centuries.
sum: West Francia was the western kingdom of the Franks, from the Treaty of Verdun in 843 to 987, and the first stage of the Kingdom of France. It is on the map for 900.
